history.subject: Layer 2 of the étale-sheafified Picard functor: picEt as the affine-opens limit with glue-based functoriality — Wave 3's functor vehicle, licensed by (C1). picEt C T is the subgroup of compatible families over the affine opens of T (Type-u-small, commutative group), collapsing at ⊤ to the affine layer (picEtAffineEquiv, naturality included); functoriality picEtMap C f is defined by the unique-pullback-value characterization — on every affine mapped into an affine, the value is the algebraic pullback — with existence by Zariski gluing over a finite basic refinement subordinate to the preimages of affines and uniqueness by Zariski separation, so choice-independence, map_id, map_comp and the group-hom property are all uniqueness arguments (no cover-versus-cover comparison); picEtFunctor : (Over Spec k)ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommGrp. The Zariski sheaf property of the plus on affines: separation instance-free via relPic finite-product decomposition; gluing consumes (C1) exactly once, as injectivity of the relPic restriction to an étale cover applied over the tensor of two covers, with localization-algebra uniqueness identifying the two refinement routes. Load-bearing new infrastructure: the clopen-partition decomposition of the Čech Picard group (separation along any partition, gluing along finite ones), the whiskered base-change pullback square, relPic of finite products in both directions, finite basic subcovers, and unit-section transport across open immersions. New files: Picard/PicEtSections, PicEt, RelPicCoverInjective, OpenImmersionUnits, CechPicClopenSep, CechPicClopenGlue, RelPicPi, PicEtAffZariskiSep, PicEtAffZariskiGlue, PicEtMapToolkit, PicEtMap. The section-of-a-point retraction of the curve product with its naturality; rigidified classes (pullback along the section trivial — a Prop, no stored data) stable under base change; Kleiman lm:idn both ways — every relative Picard class has a rigidified representative (the twist M ⋅ (p^* σ^* M)⁻¹) and rigidified representatives of equal classes are equal ON THE NOSE; the rigidified mirror of the descent-class congruence, UNCONDITIONAL: a rigidified representative of a descent class pulls back equally along Spec of any two algebra maps, hence its descent equation holds as an honest Čech-Picard equality on the double tensor — the entry point for the effectivity campaign; and the lm:aut ring heart (σ-pullback of global unit sections is bijective). Plus the sheafification unit picEtUnit : relPicFunctor ⟶ picEtFunctor in full (components instance-free, affine face = the plus unit, naturality through the unique-pullback-value API), and fromSpecAffine plumbing. Wave 2b, the dévissage short-exact sequence and the jump dimension: the sequence 0 → O(D−x) → O(D) → skyscraper_x(jump) → 0 is short exact (devissageSES_shortExact — epi via local surjectivity of the projection, excising the finite bad locus and lifting a jump-class representative; middle exactness sectionwise through the pole-lattice/jumpProj equivalence, transported to the sheaf level by limit-reflection), and the jump module is the residue field as a K-space so its dimension is the residue degree (finrank_jumpModule via the uniformizer-shift isomorphism O(D)_x/O(D−x)_x ≅ κ(x) and the first isomorphism theorem). Plus the divisor-sheaf multiplication equivalence mulEquivDivisorSheaf toward the principal-divisor degree identity. G7 closed and G8's multiplication piece landed.
